text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day,
as summer training camp was going 
smoothly... an incident occurred.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—2000m on turf. This course will do, 
correct?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Man, I'm really looking forward to 
it!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: To think I get to race with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It all started one hour ago—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During a break in training, Mr. C.B. 
suddenly came over to Mejiro Ramonu, 
and...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I want to run with you... or rather, 
I want to race you!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Is it okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—With just this... it's been decided that 
I'll face off against the Classic Triple 
Crown Umamusume, Mr. C.B.!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Ramonu. One could say that right now,
you 
are running the most freely of all."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Nothing can bind you.
Swayed by no wind at 
all...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You made me really want to run with you! 
Thanks for accepting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"To have you describe me as free is truly 
a great honor."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I'll make you feel it even more. Deep 
down inside your heart..."
choice_data_list: (Ramonu is motivated, but...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B.,
a Classic Triple Crown Umamusume 
who has also gained a wealth of race 
experience in the Senior Class...
choice_data_list: (Ramonu's eager to go, but...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On the other hand, how much of a match 
can Mejiro Ramonu put up, given she's 
still in the Classic class with so little 
experience? Though, to be completely 
honest—"
choice_data_list: (I really want to see this showdow...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just how close can Mejiro Ramonu,
boasting 
supreme strength in the current Tiara 
division, get to her? It's bound to be a 
nail-biter of a race...!
choice_data_list: (I'd really love to see this match...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And it seemed that feeling wasn't mine 
alone—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, here it is! CB-senpai and 
Ramonu-senpai's race!

text_block_list.name: Tourist A
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa...!
Those two are really gonna race 
each other!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Oh dear, the gallery is getting bigger.
choice_data_list: I wonder where they heard about it...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, I just invited her like normal. 
Maybe the girls watching started a rumor?
choice_data_list: I wonder where they heard that from.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "I don't mind. Neither does CB."
choice_data_list: What do you want to do, Ramonu?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, yeah, you're right! As long as we 
have each other, that's all that matters.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Then, before this turns into an even 
bigger commotion... let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~~! Good luck to both of you~~!
choice_data_list: (...Are you really going to be okay?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a lingering hint of unease at the 
ever-growing crowd of spectatorsâ
choice_data_list: (...Will it really be alright?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The race is underway! First, Mejiro 
Ramonu takes the lead, steadily pulling 
away from Mr. C.B....

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
! Looking good,
no openings at all... What 
a flawless, beautiful run!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The race progresses with the distance 
between the two never closing. At first 
glance, Mejiro Ramonu seems to have the 
upper hand, but...
choice_data_list: (This is where Mr. C.B. gets scary)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Alright then! It's about time... you let 
me catch you!
choice_data_list: (Where Mr. C.B. gets truly frighte...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haaah...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: (Here she comes! What an incredibl...

text_block_list.text: Ah... W-Wait a sec— Eeeeek!!
choice_data_list: (Here she comes! What a ferocious ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However... that was where the race ended. 
The crowd had grown too large, nearly 
triggering a stampede near the finish 
line.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both Mr. C.B. and Mejiro Ramonu noticed 
immediately and slowed down, so neither 
was injured, but...

...Yeah, the two of them really lo...

Geez,
I've been telling you that the whole 
time, haven't I? And yet, you still 
checked it dozens of times...
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, looks like both of them a...
...Yeah, looks like both of them a...

text_block_list.text: I know that!
choice_data_list: If anything feels off after this, ...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, with this,
I'm not even in the mood 
to start over.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...What a shame. Truly.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Right! ...Well then, I'm gonna go say hi 
to everyone for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Why? The spectators were unharmed,
weren't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but it's also partly my fault for
not 
realizing how much... buzz I'd generate, 
so it ended up like this.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
There was nothing to apologize for, 
though, so I figured a greeting would be 
just right.

I'll go check on things one more time!

text_block_list.text: What troublesome people...

By the time we finished attending to 
everything, it was already evening.

However, I gained something far more 
meaningful than that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: No.
choice_data_list: Does that come down to... experience?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Joy at the possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: That race. I would have most likely lost.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
That sheer aura CB showed at the very 
end...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Unlike anything I had ever felt before.
It 
made these legs... my entire body, 
tremble.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It was both a joy... and an unknown 
terror.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...The more I chew, the sweeter it gets...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.
choice_data_list: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Beyond the Triple Tiara... I suppose 
races that surpass even that are waiting 
for us."
choice_data_list: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The words "beyond the Triple Tiara" had 
come from Mejiro Ramonu's own lips for
the 
first time... Just hearing that made my 
heart race with anticipation.
choice_data_list: What's your goal beyond that?
What is your goal beyond that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: None at all.
choice_data_list: What's your goal beyond that?
What is your goal beyond that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
As long as this love demands it, I will 
simply keep on running.

text_block_list.text: ...Oh. Why are you laughing?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I honestly told her that during the
Oaks, 
I wanted to keep watching Mejiro Ramonu

answer."

At Hanshin Racecourse, where the Oka Sho 
is held, a steep hill awaits just before 
the finish line. In that final moment 
requiring explosive speed—

races with Mejiro Ramonu—
